teacher_info.about_teacher: I believe that students should learn through engaging, hands-on, communicative lessons. Research shows that experiential learning helps students retain knowledge for longer periods of time and express that knowledge more fluently. This helps them to move beyond their procedural understanding of the content to develop a conceptual understanding as well. I also firmly believe that in today’s society it is imperative that students develop a greater global awareness through their classroom instruction. By learning about other cultures, practices, and beliefs/values, students will be able to relate to diverse populations more appropriately.

pro_course_detail.description:
In these beginner Spanish lessons, you’ll build a strong foundation in the language with a focus on key vocabulary, grammar, and essential communication skills. We’ll start by covering the basics, such as the Spanish alphabet, numbers, and common greetings, giving you the tools to introduce yourself and have simple conversations.

As we progress, you'll learn how to describe people and things using nouns, adjectives, and articles, while also expanding your vocabulary to talk about your family. From there, we’ll dive into regular verbs in the present tense and introduce prepositions, helping you to construct simple sentences.

These lessons are designed to make learning Spanish fun and accessible. By the end, you’ll feel confident using the language in basic real-life situations. Whether you’re starting from scratch or looking to refresh your skills, you’ll find these lessons to be the perfect introduction to Spanish.

I also believe that we should always be having fun with topics and exercises that are interesting to us both. As a digital designer, I want to make our time together fun, interesting, visual, and interactive.

Do you want to develop your speaking skills and do you also have an interest in German culture and food? Then let’s have a role-play dialogue in a beer hall in Munich.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I offer a few lesson types and all include speaking. Two of my favourite courses are:

1) English through Reading: We will read through a news article, opinion article, or piece of literature that we find interesting. As we read together, we will practice using the new language that we find and you will successfully be able to use it :)

2) English through Film & Television: This course will include listening and/or reading (with subtitles, if you prefer) part of a film or TV episode. As we watch together, you will also practice using the language in real time through natural conversation

3) The other courses will focus on Native slang, Interview Prep, and General Improvement

In these lessons, I will help you improve your pronunciation and develop a more neutral American accent.

Our lessons will be tailored to your specific needs. We’ll focus on individual sounds and practice applying what we've learned by reading challenging texts, such as poetry, speeches, and tongue twisters.

During class, we will:

Work on identifying and articulating vowels and consonants
Explore how changes in intonation can affect meaning
Practice correct articulation, rhythm, and intonation
Apply principles of English sentence stress, rhythm, and linking

pro_course_detail.title: Cambridge A2 KET Exam Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
Cambridge KET Exam Preparation  

This course is designed to fully prepare your child for the Cambridge KET exam, ensuring they build a strong foundation in English. I use the Complete KET Student’s Book and Workbook to cover all essential grammar, vocabulary, reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills. Throughout the course, we will also incorporate practice tests to track progress and determine when your child is test-ready. If additional support is needed, we will use the Exam Booster for extra exam-style practice.  

The time required to prepare for KET depends on your child’s current level. It can take up to a year or more to fully develop the necessary skills to excel in the exam. My goal is not just to help them pass but to ensure they build a solid foundation for future exams like PET and FCE.  

Many students pass KET and PET based on their speaking ability alone, without mastering grammar. However, when they reach FCE, they struggle due to gaps in their grammar knowledge. That is why I emphasize a balanced approach, making sure your child is exposed to all key language areas so they can progress confidently through the Cambridge levels.  

By focusing on strong grammar, vocabulary, reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills in KET, your child will be well-prepared for future challenges. Investing in their foundation now will make their English journey smoother, and their future self will thank you.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS
pro_course_detail.description:
I believe in keeping things simple and using clear, straightforward language to help you achieve your desired band score. Many people assume that using advanced vocabulary is necessary for a high score. While that can be true to some extent, if you are not able to use advanced words correctly, it may lower your score. That is why I focus on essential linking words that can effectively improve your performance.  

In our lessons, we will explore conditional sentences with "if" to discuss possible situations, helping you express ideas with confidence. We will also work on expanding your vocabulary with words like "more," which indicate an increase in quantity or degree, enriching your writing without making it too complex.  

A key part of our sessions will be learning how to connect and extend ideas smoothly. I will show you how to use "and" and "also" to add information naturally, and how to emphasize important points with "not only... but also." We will practice using "to" and "the" for clarity and specificity, and I will explain how "which" can be used to add extra details about a noun, making your sentences clearer and more precise.  

I will encourage you to reflect on your progress, helping you think carefully about what you have learned and how to apply it effectively. We will also work on cause and effect by using "because" to explain reasons, "therefore" to show logical conclusions, and "so" to indicate results, allowing you to create well-structured arguments.  

Finally, I will guide you in using "when" to refer to specific situations and teach you how to introduce contrasting ideas with "but" or "however." With this approach, you will not only prepare effectively for your exams but also develop a strong foundation in English.  

Together, we will work towards your success.

pro_course_detail.title: Free talk
pro_course_detail.description:
Discover the joy of conversation in our one-to-one private talk classes! Whether you are an adult, a teen, or a kid, these sessions are made just for you. You'll have the chance to learn, share ideas, and practice speaking in a relaxed setting.

What's in it for you?

- Build Confidence: Enjoy personalized attention to help you feel comfortable speaking.
- Improve Communication: Learn to express your ideas clearly and listen actively.
- Make Connections: While it's a one-to-one session, you'll gain skills that help you connect with others in everyday life.

Details:

- Who Can Join: Everyone is welcome. I offer private sessions for adults, teens, and kids.
- Personalized Experience: Each session is tailored to your needs, allowing you to focus on your individual interests and goals.

Why you should join:

You will have the chance to work directly with an instructor who will guide you through interesting topics and activities. This personalized approach will help you grow your skills faster and make each session a unique learning experience.

Take the first step towards a more confident you. Sign up today and start your journey because your futureself will thank you!

teacher_info.intro: Hello! My name is Lauren and I am from Chicago, Illinois, but currently live in Las Vegas, Nevada. I have a background in vocal performance and five years of experience as an ESL teacher. I love reading and watching movies, and I have a five-year-old son that keeps me very busy! I love to travel and meet new people, and I also enjoy learning about other cultures.

teacher_info.about_teacher: I have been teaching children and adults how to speak English for almost five years, and love what I do. My goal is to help you learn the language in the best way possible. I enjoy getting to know my students and helping them succeed. Also, have several years of experience teaching voice lessons to adults and children. I hold a TEFL and TESOL certificate and have attended several different workshops to help me grow as a teacher.
teacher_info.teaching_style: In my class, we can work on specific grammar, pronunciation, and sentence structure. We can also have informal conversational lessons, that will help you in everyday English scenarios. Whether you are a beginner or more advanced, I am here to help you get to where you want to be!

exp_info.description: I have been teaching children from ages 5-14 how to speak English. Most of the students have had little or no English background, but some have been able to have an open conversation. We have worked on grammar, pronunciation, sentence structure, reading, and free talk.

edu_info.description: As a music major, I spent four years taking voice lessons, language and diction lessons, and learning music theory.
